entities.name: Query PIF1 helicase
observations: 768 aa protein with a long low-complexity, Lys/Arg/Ser/Pro-rich N-terminal region and a conserved C-terminal helicase core.
Pfam detects PIF1 domain at residues 418–620 and Pif1_2B_dom at residues 684–725; overlapping AAA-family ATPase profiles support an SF1 helicase motor.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 84.3 kDa; predicted pI is 9.65; calculated charge at pH 7 is +22.9.
The N-terminus begins with a hydrophobic stretch, but the overall architecture and strong C-terminal PIF1 homology support a nuclear/organellar helicase rather than a secreted membrane protein.

entities.name: Emericella nidulans PIF1
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference Q5AXT5 is an ATP-dependent DNA helicase with 5′–3′ DNA helicase activity.
Reference protein shares 52.8% identity over 72.3% query coverage with the query sequence; E-value 2.77e-164.
Annotated to ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, single-stranded DNA binding, DNA repair, DNA recombination, telomere maintenance, replication-fork reversal, and nuclear and mitochondrial localization.
Mg2+ is annotated as a cofactor; reference enzyme classification is EC 5.6.2.3.

entities.name: Genome stability maintenance
observations: PIF1-family helicases can couple ATP hydrolysis to 5′–3′ translocation on nucleic acids and contribute to replication, repair, recombination, telomere, and fork-processing processes.
